name: Cirrus Communications
summary: Licensed fixed-wireless broadband carrier for regional Australia; serial acquirer of small regional wireless ISPs (CommsLogic 2007, WireFree 2008, UniSky 2008, LiSP wireless, My WiSP, Chariot wireless assets); rebranded Swoop ~2020.

events.details: Cirrus Communications founded, Gosford NSW (fixed wireless).
Rebranded Swoop; merged into Swoop Holdings via reverse takeover.
